title: The range that needs a closure
promptMarkdown: Let $D:\ell^2\to\ell^2$ be $(Dx)_n=x_n/n$. Show $D=D^*$, its kernel is zero, and its range is dense but not closed. Give an explicit vector in its range closure but outside its range and an approximating sequence in the range.
hintLadder: First show every finitely supported vector is in the range.
Test the target $y_n=1/n$ and determine its only possible preimage.
